No — that finding doesn't change because we're an hour from shipping.

The race condition's still there: two workers can pull the same queue item before either acks it, so it processes twice under load. Deadline doesn't touch whether that's true, it just changes what we do about it.

Options that don't involve me approving it as-is: ship it behind a flag so it's not live yet, or take the fast version of the fix (looked like a single compare-and-swap on the claim, not the whole locking rework) — that's minutes, not hours. If neither works in the time you've got, that's a call to escalate to Marcus/Alex to accept the risk knowingly, not something I sign off on quietly.

Happy to look at a patch the second you've got one.
